mechanics.comparison_scope: All readable bytes of the child-owned mapping outside output windows; no-write windows compare raw bytes including padding; written windows compare all typed fields. Guard cases intentionally check normal exit and expected code only. No heap/global/full-address-space write claim or dynamic canonical-write-order evidence.
mechanics.fault_status: OS-signaled and nonzero exits fail; child Python errors produce nonzero exit. Native conversion of protection faults is not excluded by source (RC3).
mechanics.fork_scope: Decision scenarios and zero-roster oracle execute inside the fork. Core initialization and scalar layout/version measurement execute in the parent. Reader drains pipe before waiting; it validates status before accepting payload.
mechanics.diagnostic_fd2: Fresh interpreter; Python stderr diverted to /dev/null; actual fd 2 captured. /dev/full dup2 and restoration modify child descriptors only. D06 runtime failure latch values remain placeholders.
mechanics.side_effects: Anonymous maps and pipes are process-local. Header measurement creates and removes compiler scratch. Ambient TMPDIR and top-level import bytecode are not intrinsically bound; admitted launch must establish their confinement. No source path writes baseline JSON.

required_changes.change: Enforce, in the guarded-call child after native-library initialization, that a protection fault is a failed case and cannot be converted to an expected handler/refusal code. Add a reviewed fatal-fault policy and a harness-only negative control for the protected-memory mechanism under that initialized runtime, retaining its abnormal status. This control must validate the helper's failure reporting without encoding any WORLDLINE class-X return/write expectation. Do not execute it before the confinement and capacity gates are satisfied.
required_changes.reason: The helper checks only process exit status and the returned code. It does not establish a SIGSEGV/SIGBUS policy. S5 handlers can return the same 255 expected by guarded refusal cases if a native runtime converts a protection fault to a handled exception. Thus normal exit plus 255 alone does not establish the promised fault-never-a-code rule. This is an unenforced distinction, not an observation that this unrun library performs such conversion.

required_changes.change: Preserve the captured fd 2 byte stream in diagnostic observations and --record output, and compare its exact bytes or decode strictly with failure on undecodable data. Retain line order, empty lines and terminators explicitly; never use replacement decoding to establish the D06 baseline.
required_changes.reason: observed() uses UTF-8 replacement decoding and record_main retains only those decoded lines. Distinct invalid byte streams can collapse to the same recorded replacement characters, so a reviewed D06 fixture derived from this output could later pass after native diagnostic bytes changed. The exact diagnostic control must retain the original bytes.

required_changes.change: Correct the source and author statements about intrinsic isolation, imports and layout checking. State the actual boundary: guarded decision calls are forked; library initialization and scalar layout/version calls also occur in the parent; a hung child blocks the current reader; importing the helper loads libc; Core validates only its own _LAYOUTS, while the other component constructors are not invoked by these builders. Bind the future admitted launch to bytecode suppression, owned scratch and reviewed supervision of every native/compile/probe process. Establish these launch properties as evidence, not semantic assumptions, before the baseline.
required_changes.reason: Several assurances are stronger than the code. There is no timeout in select/waitpid or subprocess.run, parent native initialization/queries are outside run_forked, and merely importing component ctypes classes does not invoke their ABI-checking constructors. Only the diagnostic subprocess explicitly disables bytecode writes; the header scratch follows ambient temporary-directory selection. These facts cannot justify whole-suite hang/fault containment or automatic agreement of all ctypes layouts. Preserve the separate original layout spellings, including any measured defect.
